settings.hero_desc: Football awards in gleaming gold - a Golden Boot and a Golden Glove, each mounted on a black base with an engraved plaque. The perfect trophies for top scorer and best goalkeeper in any league, tournament or club season.

settings.s1_body: Give your league's standout players an award worthy of the moment. These gold football trophies - a Golden Boot for the top scorer and a Golden Glove for the best keeper - are sculpted, finished in rich gold and mounted on engraved bases. Ideal for amateur leagues, corporate tournaments, schools and clubs, and we can create matching awards for any category you run.
settings.case_body: Created as a Golden Boot and Golden Glove set for a football league, these trophies gave the end-of-season awards real prestige - personalised, premium and genuinely coveted by the players.
settings.case_quote: Our players loved them. The gold boot and glove gave our awards night a real pro feel.
settings.prov_p: The Golden Boot and Golden Glove are football's most coveted individual honours. Recreated as custom trophies, they bring that same prestige to your league, club or tournament.
